idea-plugin.name: Chalii Themes
idea-plugin.description:
Premium light and dark themes for JetBrains IDEs with warm orange accents and excellent readability.

Ships Chalii Light and Chalii Dark, both generated from the same source-of-truth palette used by the VS Code, Sublime, Zed, and terminal ports of the Chalii theme family.

Works in IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, PyCharm, GoLand, RustRover, Rider, PhpStorm, RubyMine, and Android Studio.
